name: Tsurushi
source:
Ando Reina.. She is my current lover. Cute face and fine body suitable to it. She is also quite popular.

However, recently she has started becoming annoying. If she does not know of my each and every action anyhow, she cannot be satsified. She is a female on the verge of becoming a stalker.

It is troublesome. Actually before Reina, I was going out with Sakakibara Miho. She is pretty unreserved, a good female. She has no desire to monopolize, loves sex and is further my type.

I only wanted to go out with Miho, so I thought...

I consulted with my friend Nakada, to make plans regarding breaking up with Reina. Nakada is an outrageous and inhumane character, even more than I thought. To start off, gets her raped by the homeless guys of the town. He started carrying out various schemes even unthinkable from my standards.

Whoa.. This is awful..

During this opportunity, Reina's friend, a woman named Azumaru Aya got wind of this situation and started giving lots of advice to Reina for the sake of returning to our previous relationship. Because of the fact, I am trying to get Reina's attention and set her up, it is convenient for me.

Once, teacher also joined a number of guys and flooded them with semen. Contrary to Aya's brave co-operation, Reina gradually became miserable.

The covered Aya, looks pretty cute! Eh? Do I like Aya?

Evil Nakada, sex loving Miho, miserable Reina, facing the backfire of her plans Aya and frivolous, I.

The rotten relationships of these 5 people, where will they end up?
Surely...

[Translated from [url=http://www.ume.gr.jp/product/dz/sakasa_t/sakasa_t.html]website[/url]]
translation:
安藤丽奈……她是我现在的女朋友。可爱的面容和与之相称的好身材，她还相当受欢迎。

然而，最近她开始变得烦人了。如果不知道我的每一个举动，她就不满足。她已经处于跟踪狂的边缘了。

真麻烦。其实在丽奈之前，我和榊原美穗交往过。她非常大方，是个好女人。没有独占欲，喜欢性爱，更合我的类型。

我只想和美穗交往，于是我这么想着……

我向朋友中田咨询，制定了和丽奈分手的计划。中田是个比我想象中更加离谱和没有人性的家伙。他一上来就让镇上的流浪汉去强奸她。他开始实施各种连我都想不到的计谋。

哇……这太过分了……

趁此机会，丽奈的朋友东丸绫察觉到了情况，为了帮助丽奈恢复我们的关系，开始给她出了很多主意。这对我来说正方便，因为我正试图引起丽奈的注意来设局。

有一次，老师也加入了一群男人的行列，用精液淹没了她们。与绫的勇敢合作相反，丽奈逐渐变得凄惨。

被淋满的绫，看起来挺可爱的！嗯？难道我喜欢绫？

邪恶的中田、好色的美穗、凄惨的丽奈、计划反噬的绫，以及轻浮的我。

这五个人腐朽的关系，究竟会走向何方？
大概……
